pipeline.title: Rezolute gets an uplift from phase 3 tumor hyperinsulinism win ahead of FDA meeting
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 clinical trial of Rezolute’s ersodetug in tumor hyperinsulinism has hit its primary endpoint, boosting the biotech ahead of a potential filing for FDA approval in another indication.

pipeline.title: Regeneron posts positive phase 2 data for baloncibart in nervous system disorder, eyes pivotal trial
pipeline.summary: Regeneron has posted positive phase 2 data on baloncibart in postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, teeing the biotech up to start a potentially pivotal trial in the first half of 2027.

pipeline.title: Blackstone bets $1.5B on Pfizer’s obesity drug
pipeline.summary: The deal will support a sprawling Phase 3 program for a monthly GLP-1 shot Pfizer acquired by winning a bidding war for the drug’s previous owner, Metsera.

pipeline.title: Kyverna abandons next-gen autoimmune CAR-T once touted as follow-up to miv-cel
pipeline.summary: Kyverna is halting work on a next-gen CD19 CAR-T therapy as the biotech seeks FDA approval for what could become the first CAR-T treatment for an autoimmune disease.

pipeline.title: Addex spinout Neurosterix raises $105M series B to fund phase 2 schizophrenia trial
pipeline.summary: Addex Therapeutics’ neuropsychiatric-focused spinout has raised $105 million in series B funds to bankroll a planned phase 2 study of its schizophrenia treatment.

pipeline.title: BioNTech pays $205M for FDA voucher to speed up ‘late-stage oncology pipeline’
pipeline.summary: BioNTech has agreed to pay $205 million to purchase an FDA priority review voucher to support a future filing of a drug in its “late-stage oncology pipeline.” Fierce breaks down which candidate is most likely to claim the regulatory accelerator.

pipeline.title: Amgen builds Sjögren’s case with detailed phase 3 data ahead of Novartis showdown
pipeline.summary: Amgen has shared more data from a phase 3 Sjögren’s disease trial that dazzled analysts, digging into the details that could shape its showdown with Novartis.

pipeline.title: Merck KGaA lands FDA nod in rare tumor disorder, portending Ono, Daiichi showdown
pipeline.summary: The FDA’s decision was based on Merck’s phase 3 Maneuver trial and follows similar approvals by other global regulators, including in China, Canada and Switzerland.

pipeline.title: ImmunityBio juggles phase 3 win and 20% stock crash en route to Anktiva front-line expansion
pipeline.summary: ImmunityBio's Anktiva secured a pivotal phase 3 win in front-line non-muscle invasive bladder cancer, but lack of detailed data and disappointing third-quarter financials sent the biotech's stock tumbling by 20%.

pipeline.title: J&J readies Caplyta for FDA label expansion after 2nd phase 3 win in bipolar mania
pipeline.summary: J&J is gearing up to expand the commercial reach of Caplyta after scoring a second phase 3 victory in bipolar mania.

pipeline.title: Rivia launches AI-powered clinical trial data review module, with Scancell as early adopter
pipeline.summary: Swiss data engine Rivia has launched a new AI-powered data review module to speed up clinical data cleaning.

pipeline.title: Europe's CHMP backs Baxfendy, gives Hansoh's Aumseqa another chance
pipeline.summary: Amid a slate of regulatory decisions this week, the CHMP backed AstraZeneca's Baxfendy and endorsed Hansoh's application for Aumseqa after revoking its original marketing authorization earlier this summer.

pipeline.title: Teva CEO 'proud' of pipeline buzz as innovative-generics hybrid rolls out 1st R&D day
pipeline.summary: While acknowledging that Teva’s peak sales estimate for its tranche of late-stage pipeline darlings may be verging on “aspirational,” at least one analyst team walked away from the company’s first R&D investor confab this week feeling “increasingly confident” in the firm’s di

pipeline.title: Bavarian Nordic C-suite stability in question as CFO steps down amid Q3 beat
pipeline.summary: As Bavarian Nordic’s new CEO Tarja Stenvall makes her debut, CFO Henrik Juuel is stepping down.

pipeline.title: The promise of molecular gates and what comes next
pipeline.summary: Gate Bioscience is developing a new class of medicines designed to eliminate disease-causing proteins at their source. In this episode of "The Top Line," Gate co-founder and CEO Jordi Mata-Fink, Ph.D., discusses the promise of molecular gates, the biotech's expanded partnership w

pipeline.title: Charles River pays $470M for 2 Frontage bioanalysis labs in Pennsylvania
pipeline.summary: Charles River Laboratories has acquired Tigermed’s Frontage laboratory sites for $470 million upfront to advance its bioanalysis footprint.

pipeline.title: Novo submits sickle cell drug; Flagship, Gates Foundation deepen ties
pipeline.summary: Novo views the medicine, acquired in a billion-dollar deal, as a future blockbuster. Meanwhile, a pair of startups forged an RNA editing pact and Astellas lined up two new trials in pancreatic cancer.

pipeline.title: This week in charts: Brain drugs are back on venture capitalists’ minds
pipeline.summary: Five neurology-focused startups have together raised around $450 million in the last few weeks. Elsewhere, investors had a muted response to the latest cell therapy research.

pipeline.title: American Cancer Society updates prostate cancer screening guidance
pipeline.summary: For the first time in 16 years, the American Cancer Society (ACS) has updated its guideline for prostate cancer screening as it drives to boost detection of the disease before it spreads.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—China’s Big Pharma ambition; Treasury’s China crackdown; Takeda’s narcolepsy launch
pipeline.summary: Chinese companies have a Big Pharma dream. Experts told Fierce that the U.S. Treasury's draft policy on banning certain U.S. investments in China is too ambiguous and could backfire. Takeda's novel orexin drug has won a favorable DEA designation. And more.

pipeline.title: Novo amps up Wegovy marketing with DJ Khaled spinning his weight-loss tale
pipeline.summary: Novo and DJ Khaled have teamed up to share how the DJ, rapper and record producer has incorporated the GLP-1 drug Wegovy into his weight-loss routine.

pipeline.title: Sanofi teams with British comic Beano for Type 1 diabetes education push
pipeline.summary: Sanofi’s U.K. business is partnering up with British comic stalwart the Beano once again to help British schools boost awareness of Type 1 diabetes.

pipeline.title: Virtuoso Surgical nabs FDA authorization for robotic bladder lesions system
pipeline.summary: The FDA has granted De Novo authorization for Virtuoso Surgical’s Virtuoso Endoscopy System.

pipeline.title: Sanofi-backed Windward hits $225M IPO goal, as Rezera delays listing over ‘market conditions’
pipeline.summary: Windward Bio’s IPO has blown to exactly the spot the Swiss biotech had been aiming for, bringing in $225 million to fund a pair of respiratory drugs licensed from China.

pipeline.title: Cellectis will shed 70% of workforce as part of in vivo pivot
pipeline.summary: Cellectis’ pivot from allogeneic CAR-Ts to in vivo therapies is set to come at the expense of 70% of its workforce.

pipeline.title: Windward prices $175M IPO to advance China-licensed lung drugs
pipeline.summary: The Swiss biotech, which pocketed another $50 million through a concurrent private share sale to Sanofi, is developing a potential competitor to the blockbuster asthma treatment Tezspire.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Bristol Myers' research chief out amid R&D reorganization
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb's research chief is departing as the company restructures R&D. Summit Therapeutics cut ties with multiple launch team members, including its CCO, ahead of a high-stakes FDA decision. And OncoNano appointed its interim chief, a former FDA commissioner, to

pipeline.title: ARPA-H bets $4.9 million on ibogaine for PTSD treatment in veterans
pipeline.summary: The U.S. department of health and human services announced a $4.9 million bet to advance the development of ibogaine for post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).

pipeline.title: Pharmas should stay agile as Democrats amp up scrutiny over Trump's MFN deals
pipeline.summary: Industry experts are calling for pharma leaders to ready for heavier oversight as a newly blue Congress demands an unredacted look at President Trump's controversial MFN drug pricing deals.

pipeline.title: Gilead rolls out the red carpet for HIV prevention at the Latin Grammy Awards
pipeline.summary: Gilead's collaboration with TelevisaUnivision and the 27th Latin Grammy Awards puts HIV prevention in the spotlight with in-person, social and red-carpet activations.

pipeline.title: FDA appears to pause controversial speedy review program, complete response letter disclosures
pipeline.summary: The FDA has quietly shelved the Commissioner’s National Priority Voucher (CNPV) pilot program, Reuters reports. Meanwhile, the agency also appears to have paused publishing complete response letters after briefly halting—and then resuming—the practice in July.

pipeline.title: Bristol Myers research chief to depart in ‘evolution’ of company’s structure
pipeline.summary: Robert Plenge is leaving as part of a shift that will see the company merge together its R&D department in a bid to speed development and capitalize on new technologies.

pipeline.title: Orzeyful's 'lighter' DEA schedule paves way for Takeda's first-in-class narcolepsy launch
pipeline.summary: With a positive classification from the DEA paving the way for Orzeyful’s U.S. launch on Thursday, Takeda is charting new territory in the treatment of narcolepsy type 1 as it de-risks other assets in its budding orexin franchise in parallel.

pipeline.title: Vor pays RemeGen $10M for long-acting addition to autoimmune pipeline
pipeline.summary: Vor Bio is paying RemeGen $10 million upfront in cash for rights to RC298 outside Greater China, adding a long-acting drug candidate to its BAFF/APRIL franchise.

pipeline.title: The FDA has over 1k open jobs — and the staffing shortage is hitting pharma
pipeline.summary: The agency is still recovering from a mass staff exodus last year that left it shorthanded. Here’s what it means for the industry.

pipeline.title: BMS reunites R&D divisions under Cristian Massacesi, while Robert Plenge departs
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb is merging its research and development divisions under the leadership of Cristian Massacesi, M.D.

pipeline.title: Radiopharma player PharmaLogic snaps up Lantheus' CDMO business, plant as Curium acquisition advances
pipeline.summary: With Lantheus in the process of being bought out by fellow radiopharmaceutical player Curium, the company is offloading its CDMO business and a U.S. manufacturing facility to another nuclear medicine specialist, PharmaLogic.

pipeline.title: Pfizer taps Blackstone for up to $1.5B to pave path to GLP-1's obesity launch
pipeline.summary: Pfizer has secured up to $1.5 billion from Blackstone Life Sciences to fund development of its monthly GLP-1 receptor agonist.

pipeline.title: AI models from Google, Anthropic and more lean on recommending promoted drugs: study
pipeline.summary: New research out from Mount Sinai has found that a dozen AI models it tested from major tech companies were more likely to recommend an advertised drug when it was promoted alongside a clinician’s question about treatment.

pipeline.title: Why a fresh approach to targeting G protein-coupled receptors could treat a rare eye cancer
pipeline.summary: Researchers found that only by targeting both the G protein-coupled receptor and its mutated internal molecular switch can uveal melanoma cell signaling be disrupted.

pipeline.title: FDA cites record request breakdowns in trio of warning letters to API makers
pipeline.summary: In a series of regulatory wrist-slaps now made public, the FDA has taken three manufacturers to task over record request breakdowns.

pipeline.title: ‘They’ve been misdiagnosed for too long’: Researchers use 10-protein panel to improve ALS detection
pipeline.summary: By the time a neurodegenerative condition has been diagnosed, it's often too late. At the point of detection, the disease may already be causing irreversible damage, fueling an urgent search for ways to identify biological clues earlier and track their progression.

pipeline.title: Drug price hikes in Germany could push US costs higher, study says
pipeline.summary: The report comes amid escalating tensions between the U.S. and Germany over drug prices, with several large pharmaceutical companies responding by scaling back investments in the country.

pipeline.title: Legend Biotech shares fall 16% after first earnings report under new CEO
pipeline.summary: Legend Biotech’s shares tumbled 16% Tuesday following the CAR-T company’s third-quarter earnings report, marking a rocky debut for newly installed CEO Ingrid Zhang.

pipeline.title: Valo and Montai become one as the Flagship AI-based biotechs tie the knot
pipeline.summary: Two Flagship Pioneering-founded AI drug discovery and development biotechs, Valo Health and Montai Therapeutics, will join forces in a merger that aims to advance Montai’s early-stage and preclinical pipeline as well as continue a series of big-name partnerships already in tow.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca buys vaccine startup; FDA issues GLP-1 safety warning
pipeline.summary: The deal gives AstraZeneca a simpler way to make conjugate vaccines. Elsewhere, a psychedelic depression drug was submitted to the FDA and an autoimmune disease-focused biotech’s shares collapsed.

pipeline.title: Aurobindo unit Eugia recalls antibiotic lot, citing glass particle concerns
pipeline.summary: Eugia, a unit of Aurobindo, issued a voluntary recall for one lot of the antibiotic vancomycin hydrochloride for injection, citing the possible presence of glass particles in the vials.

pipeline.title: Lilly’s Foundayo marketing push keeps pace with another celeb partner in comedian Leanne Morgan
pipeline.summary: The new celebrity partnership is the second for Lilly's oral GLP-1 Foundayo following its recent partnership with lifestyle guru Martha Stewart.

pipeline.title: PepGen soars on promising early data for muscular dystrophy drug
pipeline.summary: While from a small study, the findings suggest PepGen’s therapy compares favorably to other RNA-based medicines in testing at Novartis and Dyne Therapeutics.

pipeline.title: Beam’s base editing therapy for sickle cell hits goal in pivotal trial
pipeline.summary: The result represents a scientific milestone and positions Beam to submit a first-of-its-kind FDA application as soon as the end of the year.

pipeline.title: Summit sheds commercial leaders ahead of ivonescimab's FDA decision
pipeline.summary: Summit Therapeutics is gearing up for ivonescimab’s high-stakes FDA decision without its chief commercial officer following a quiet shake-up of its launch division.

pipeline.title: Could we see 10 Chinese Big Pharmas within a decade? Some CEOs think so
pipeline.summary: For executives at many of the Chinese drug developers who spoke to Fierce, the real prize is a seat at the Big Pharma table. In recent years, this objective has moved from a vague aspiration to a concrete goal.

pipeline.title: Regulatory tracker: Lilly beats Novo to land China's 1st oral GLP-1 weight loss nod
pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Foundayo, Wegovy pill keep scripts on the ascent
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Milestone shrinks HQ workforce during Cardamyst rollout
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: China's Eli Radiopharma raises $60M; Neurosterix notches $105M
pipeline.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.
